input.query: Sentry vs Rollbar vs Bugsnag pricing 2026 error monitoring plans
Bugsnag pricing plans events per month 2026
Rollbar pricing plans 2026 Essentials Advanced events

content.text:
**Recommendation: Sentry**, unless your team is mostly mobile apps, in which case Bugsnag is the stronger fit.

| | Sentry | Bugsnag | Rollbar |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best known for | Broad platform: errors, tracing, performance, session replay, many SDKs | Mobile and app stability, release health | Error grouping and a query language (RQL) |
| Free tier | Yes | Yes (one user, about 7.5K events/month per the vendor page) | Yes |
| Pricing transparency | Published tiers | Published tiers, with Enterprise quoted | Mostly quote-based now |
| Self-hosting | Yes (open source) | No | No |
| Ecosystem and community | Largest | Mid-sized | Smaller |
| Fit for a 10-person team | Strongest default: good free tier, wide integrations, room to grow | Good if you ship mobile apps and care about crash-free sessions | Viable, but fewer people use it, so less help and fewer examples |

**Why Sentry:** it covers the most ground for one tool (errors, tracing, replay), has the widest SDK and integration coverage (GitHub, Slack, Jira/Linear), and the team will find the most documentation and community answers. Self-hosting is an option if data residency matters.

**When Bugsnag wins:** your product is mainly iOS/Android, and you want crash-free-session metrics and release tracking front and center.

**When Rollbar wins:** you want its grouping and query tooling and are comfortable with a smaller community. I'd only pick it for a specific feature need.

**Pricing caveat:** I could not get reliable current prices. The search results conflicted, with the same plan showing different prices across aggregator sites, and Rollbar's public list prices appear to have been replaced by quotes. Before deciding, check each vendor's pricing page and estimate your monthly event volume, since that is what drives cost. Event volume is the number to confirm first.

Sources I checked (mostly third-party aggregators, so treat their figures as unverified):
- [Bugsnag pricing](https://bugsnag.com/pricing)
- [Bugsnag plans and billing docs](https://docs.bugsnag.com/product/plans-and-billing)
- [Rollbar pricing explained](https://rollbar.com/blog/rollbar-pricing-explained-plans-features-and-what-you-actually-pay)
- [Sentry vs Rollbar 2026 comparison](https://costbench.com/compare/sentry-vs-rollbar/)
- [Sentry vs Bugsnag](https://cubeapm.com/blog/sentry-vs-bugsnag/)

If you tell me your main stack (web, mobile, backend languages) and rough monthly event volume, I can narrow this to one pick.
